tasks.label: build client
tasks.command: mkdir -p build && g++ -std=c++20 -Wall -Wextra src/tcp_echo_client.cpp src/socket_utils.cpp -o build/tcp_echo_client

tasks.label: build server
tasks.command: mkdir -p build && g++ -std=c++20 -Wall -Wextra src/tcp_echo_server.cpp src/socket_utils.cpp -o build/tcp_echo_server

tasks.label: build all
tasks.command: mkdir -p build && g++ -std=c++20 -Wall -Wextra src/tcp_echo_client.cpp src/socket_utils.cpp -o build/tcp_echo_client && g++ -std=c++20 -Wall -Wextra src/tcp_echo_server.cpp src/socket_utils.cpp -o build/tcp_echo_server
